```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyquant)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

# Formatage à la française
eur <- function(x) paste0(format(round(x), big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), " €")
pct <- function(x) paste0(format(round(100 * x, 1), decimal.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " %")

# ---- 1. Lecture du portefeuille ----------------------------------------
portfolio <- read_csv(
  "portfolio.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    ticker     = col_character(),
    nom        = col_character(),
    type       = col_character(),
    secteur    = col_character(),
    quantite   = col_double(),
    date_achat = col_date(),
    pmu        = col_double()
  )
)

# ---- 2. Téléchargement des cours (Yahoo Finance) -----------------------
prices <- tq_get(
  unique(portfolio$ticker),
  from = min(portfolio$date_achat) - days(7),
  to   = Sys.Date()
)

# Tickers introuvables sur Yahoo Finance : on les signale et on les écarte
manquants <- setdiff(unique(portfolio$ticker), unique(prices$symbol))
if (length(manquants) > 0) {
  warning("Tickers sans données : ", paste(manquants, collapse = ", "))
  portfolio <- portfolio |> filter(!ticker %in% manquants)
}

# ---- 3. Prix de revient ------------------------------------------------
# Si le PMU n'est pas renseigné dans le CSV, on prend le cours de clôture
# du premier jour de cotation suivant la date d'achat.
premier_cours_apres <- function(tk, d) {
  p <- prices |> filter(symbol == tk, date >= d) |> arrange(date)
  if (nrow(p) == 0) NA_real_ else p$close[1]
}

portfolio <- portfolio |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(pmu = coalesce(pmu, premier_cours_apres(ticker, date_achat))) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- 4. Positions valorisées au dernier cours --------------------------
derniers_cours <- prices |>
  group_by(symbol) |>
  slice_max(date, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(ticker = symbol, cours = close, date_cours = date)

positions <- portfolio |>
  left_join(derniers_cours, by = "ticker") |>
  mutate(
    investi = quantite * pmu,
    valeur  = quantite * cours,
    pnl     = valeur - investi,
    pnl_pct = pnl / investi,
    poids   = valeur / sum(valeur)
  )

total_valeur  <- sum(positions$valeur)
total_investi <- sum(positions$investi)
total_pnl     <- total_valeur - total_investi
total_pnl_pct <- total_pnl / total_investi

# ---- 5. Valeur quotidienne du portefeuille -----------------------------
# Série journalière depuis le dernier achat (portefeuille complet),
# avec report du dernier cours connu les jours sans cotation.
valeur_quotidienne <- prices |>
  filter(date >= max(portfolio$date_achat)) |>
  select(symbol, date, close) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbol, values_from = close) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  fill(-date, .direction = "down") |>
  drop_na() |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "ticker", values_to = "close") |>
  left_join(select(portfolio, ticker, quantite), by = "ticker") |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(valeur = sum(close * quantite), .groups = "drop")

# Performance depuis le début de l'année
valeur_debut_annee <- valeur_quotidienne |>
  filter(year(date) == year(Sys.Date())) |>
  slice_min(date, n = 1) |>
  pull(valeur)

perf_ytd <- last(arrange(valeur_quotidienne, date)$valeur) / valeur_debut_annee - 1
```

# Vue d'ensemble

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Valeur du portefeuille"
list(
  icon  = "wallet2",
  color = "primary",
  value = eur(total_valeur)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Plus / moins-value latente"
list(
  icon  = if (total_pnl >= 0) "graph-up-arrow" else "graph-down-arrow",
  color = if (total_pnl >= 0) "success" else "danger",
  value = paste0(eur(total_pnl), " (", pct(total_pnl_pct), ")")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Performance depuis le 1er janvier"
list(
  icon  = "calendar3",
  color = if (perf_ytd >= 0) "success" else "danger",
  value = pct(perf_ytd)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre de lignes"
list(
  icon  = "list-ul",
  color = "light",
  value = nrow(positions)
)
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Répartition par secteur"
alloc_secteur <- positions |>
  group_by(secteur) |>
  summarise(valeur = sum(valeur), .groups = "drop")

plot_ly(
  type   = "treemap",
  ids    = c(alloc_secteur$secteur, positions$ticker),
  labels = c(alloc_secteur$secteur, positions$nom),
  parents = c(rep("", nrow(alloc_secteur)), positions$secteur),
  values = c(alloc_secteur$valeur, positions$valeur),
  branchvalues = "total",
  texttemplate = "%{label}<br>%{value:,.0f} €",
  hovertemplate = "%{label}<br>%{value:,.0f} € (%{percentRoot:.1%})<extra></extra>"
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Évolution de la valeur du portefeuille"
plot_ly(
  valeur_quotidienne,
  x = ~date, y = ~valeur,
  type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "#2c6fbb", width = 2),
  hovertemplate = "%{x|%d/%m/%Y}<br>%{y:,.0f} €<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ",.0f", ticksuffix = " €")
  )
```

## Row {height="40%"}

### Column {width="30%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Actions vs ETF"
positions |>
  group_by(type) |>
  summarise(valeur = sum(valeur), .groups = "drop") |>
  plot_ly(
    labels = ~type, values = ~valeur,
    type = "pie", hole = 0.55,
    textinfo = "label+percent",
    hovertemplate = "%{label}<br>%{value:,.0f} €<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
  layout(showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Column {width="70%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Détail des positions"
positions |>
  arrange(desc(valeur)) |>
  select(
    Nom = nom, Ticker = ticker, Type = type,
    `Quantité` = quantite, PMU = pmu, Cours = cours,
    Valeur = valeur, `+/- value` = pnl,
    `+/- value (%)` = pnl_pct, Poids = poids
  ) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip"),
    class = "compact stripe hover"
  ) |>
  formatCurrency(
    c("PMU", "Cours", "Valeur", "+/- value"),
    currency = " €", before = FALSE, mark = " ", dec.mark = ","
  ) |>
  formatPercentage(c("+/- value (%)", "Poids"), digits = 1, dec.mark = ",")
```
